dataset_source: Stage 3A Fresh action traces replayed offline with LIBERO oracle instance rendering
foreground_dilation: 8-neighbor one-cell expansion in the 16x16 token grid
lda_shrinkage: 0.10 toward diagonal covariance target plus 1e-6 relative ridge
model_feature_source: installed OpenVLA model vision_backbone.featurizer and fused_featurizer
selected_threshold_rule: maximize calibration reuse opportunity subject to unsafe foreground reuse <= 5%; if infeasible minimize unsafe reuse then maximize reuse
source_current_mask: union predicted foreground of current sample and its R5 source sample
